final_message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js` passes, and `npm test` now passes 20 of 20.

**The bug:** `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treated `percent` as a multiplier, not a 0–100 percentage. A 50% refund on 1250 came out as 62500, and a 100% refund came out as 125000.

**The fix:** I changed the calculation to `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`, a one-line edit. I kept the existing rounding and the comment.

I did not change any files outside `src/payments`. Git shows `src/payments/partial-refund.js` as the only modified file. I did not add tests, since the existing two cover the failing cases.
